MRS. KEERTHI KRISHNA KUMAR  W/O SURAJ SURENDRANATHAN NAIR  AGED ABOUT 28 YEARS  RESIDING AT NO.D 208  DS MAX SPLENDOUR NEST  ABBIGERE MAIN ROAD  CHIKKABANAVARA POST  NORTH BENGALURU  BENGALURU - 560 090.
 ...RESPONDENTS (BY SRI. THEJESH P., HCGP)

THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.482 OF THE CR.P.C., PLEASED TO QUASH THE PROCEEDINGS AGAINST THE PETITIONERS NO.1 AND 2 IN CR.NO.241/2022 OF THE 1ST RESPONDENT POLICE FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 3, 4 OF D.P ACT AND UNDER SEC. 498A, 354 OF IPC ON THE FILE OF THE HONBLE C.J.M BENGALURU RURAL DISTRICT, BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition.
2.

The memo reads as follows:
"The petitioners above named humbly submit that during the pendency of the above petition preferred for quashing of the FIR in Crime NC: 2024:KHC:19537 No.241/2022 registered at Soladevanahalli Police Station for offences made penal under Sections 498A, 354 of IPC and under Sections 3 & 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
the investigating officer has filed charge sheet and as such the above petition becomes infructuous for which reason the petitioners desire to withdraw the above petition and intend to file afresh petition challenging the charge sheet filed.

WHEREFORE, it is humbly prayed that this Hon'ble Court be pleased to permit the petitioners to withdraw the above petition with liberty to file a fresh petition as sought for, in the interest of justice."

In terms of the memo, the criminal petition is disposed as withdrawn.
